    CHAPTER I

The mark “ was left floating in the middle of this line by itself.

“ A line beginning with a floating open quote and then a space.

The quote sits at the very end of this particular line here “

He turned to her and said.“That is quite enough of it for today.”

The word before“the quote has no space between them at any point.

“Come in,”she said, without troubling to look up from her sewing.

“This paragraph is quoted correctly from beginning to end,” he said.
